title: NIST WebBook: Ethanol is C2H6O, molecular weight 46.0684 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Ethanol as C2H6O, molecular weight 46.0684 amu, CAS 64-17-5.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Ethanol, CAS Registry Number 64-17-5, lists molecular formula C2H6O and molecular weight 46.0684 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 46.0418648 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C2H6O/c1-2-3/h3H,2H2,1H3. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
